record.body:
## Description

R21: The effort page lists the phases as rows, each with a progress bar.
R22: A phase row on the effort page links to `#/phase/<effort>/<phase>`.
R23: The effort page has no task table.
R24: The effort page has no status tabs.

## Approach

Read the frozen tests in `dashboard/frontend/src/lib/screens/effortPhaseRows.test.ts` first. They mount `App` and fix the selectors.

- `Home.svelte`: replace the phase stepper and the phase buttons with rows. Each row is an `<a data-phase="<subject>" href={phaseHref(...)}>` with the title (or subject), the done/total count and a progress bar (`role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`). Milestone groups and their toggles stay. Remove the `All phases` control, the status tabs and the task table.
- `polling.svelte.ts`: remove `pinnedPhase`, `statusTab`, `tabPinnedFor`, `phaseSubject`, `tasks`, `counts`, `selectPhase`, `activatePhase`, `chooseTab`, `openPhase`, the default-tab effect, and the pinned-phase handling in the milestone route effect and in `initialExpandedMilestones`. Keep milestone expansion. Fix every caller.
- `overlay.svelte.ts` `linkCtx`: replace `polling.phaseSubject` with the phase of the task in the snapshot, or the route phase.
- Update or delete the tests that assert the removed controls: `main.test.ts` (`data-phase-control`, `data-status-tabs`), `milestoneNav.test.ts` (stepper, `selectPhase`, `activatePhase`, `All phases`), `lib/screens/areas.test.ts` (`[data-task-table]` on the effort page). Keep the milestone grouping tests. Run `npm test` and fix each other failure the same way.
- Close with `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`.

payload.title: Turn the effort page phases into linked rows
